meta.title: H3 Image (local MLX)
meta.description: Unofficial third-party plugin, not affiliated with MiniMax. On Apple Silicon, fully local text-to-image with the open-source MiniMax H3-Image (MLX engine). A one-time setup wizard downloads a fixed version of the engine and weights to your machine (the MiniMax community license and its region terms are shown before any download; you accept it yourself), then generation runs offline — no keys, no accounts, no network access. Long setup steps are background jobs that survive restarts and resume where they stopped. Requires Apple Silicon with 48 GB+ unified memory (32 GB is not guaranteed) and ~60 GB free disk during setup; Intel Macs and other platforms are declined up front. Current version (0.2.5): read-only environment check, setup wizard, and local generation (the community license must be explicitly accepted by you before the first image).
